name: Dr. Evil Laser
look: Dr. Evil, played by Mike Myers, is bald and wears a gray Nehru-collar suit. He raises both hands making air quotes with his fingers, mouth open mid-word, in front of a riveted metal wall with a small cratered moon model below him.
use: Puts a word in sarcastic air quotes to mock how something is described. The top caption sets up the thing and the bottom caption holds the dubious word in quotes, like a "healthy" snack or a "quick" meeting.
slots: bottom caption: the word or phrase in sarcastic air quotes
describe: bald villain doing air quotes with both hands
dr evil making quote marks with his fingers
mike myers in a gray suit doing finger quotes
villain next to a moon model sarcastically saying a word
bald man in a nehru suit holding up two fingers on each hand
origin: Mike Myers as Dr. Evil making air quotes around the word "laser" in the Austin Powers films.
